utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the eighth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, you're through. Bit of a delay on Teams, that's all.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Probably a blessing if we're discussing the football last night. What a finish.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Don't. Turned it off five minutes early, didn't I.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Safer subject — the charity bake sale on Friday. Apparently there's actual competition over the brownies now.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Factory runs on tea and competitive baking. Always has.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the cake meeting. Finished bits first, then what we're agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I've signed off the inspection on the air dryer on Tuesday — that's this morning, for anyone reading the notes later. That one's done.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I've signed off the inspection on the dryer on Tuesday, this morning as well. Mine's closed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Both completed inspections, nothing new coming out of those here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Also, finished the repair on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot last night. That's finished, not something I'm carrying forward.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, got that. Nice to have a finished one for a change.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the GT2 inlet valve dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Came right back, rather than sitting a bit low?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, right back. Just passing on what I saw, not putting a new job up for it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 1 mould temp. Still blocked; no change to report there.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same position here: the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the dryer. That remains blocked as well.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, both still waiting on confirmation. Nothing newly released from those, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide, can you check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 2? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yes, I'll check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 2 straight away.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, that isn't one to disappear halfway down the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Safety critical, straight away, as we've said.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And separately, I'll take vibration readings on the air compressor by Thursday. That's me volunteering for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Olumide. Air compressor readings by Thursday, separate from the immediate guarding check.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep. Two different items, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: David Whitfield, can you do the pre-use checks on the FLTs tomorrow at 9:30? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs tomorrow at 9:30. Top priority, got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out slightly. Nine thirty tomorrow, not this morning?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30. That's the timing for those checks.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's what I've got as well. No problem.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll run a function test on the Compressed Air Dryer on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just so the wording doesn't get muddled with the completed inspections — that's the function test you're taking?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, function test on the Compressed Air Dryer, on Friday. Not reopening either of the inspection sign-offs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely, Grace. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you chase the purchase order for the boiler safety valve? It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that chase on. Haven't got the capacity for the back-and-forth on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Grace, can I hand that to you instead — chase the purchase order for the boiler safety valve? Still fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take it instead of Hannah. I'll chase the purchase order for the boiler safety valve.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fairly important, you said? Sorry, two people came through together there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, fairly important. I haven't put a specific deadline on that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Olumide, could you book a contractor to look at the GT1 compressor? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't take the booking as well, sorry. With the guarding and the readings, I'd rather not say yes and then sit on it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fair enough. Hannah, could you take that instead — book a contractor to look at the GT1 compressor? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that booking I can take. I'll book a contractor to look at the GT1 compressor instead of Olumide.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Normal priority for that booking, not the same urgency as the guarding.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fi. Toolbox talk organisation with you this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. Sorry, wasn't trying to talk over you — the delay's making us sound even less organised than usual.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: We're doing our best. And I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the site water tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Fiona. The permit to work and isolation for the site water, tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, tomorrow. That's mine as well.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just the permit and isolation we're agreeing here, not adding a repair onto that?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Correct. Permit to work and isolation for the site water. No extra repair job.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I'll do a site visit at Harbour Road with the contractor.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace — whenever you get a chance for that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, whenever I get a chance. I'll take the Harbour Road visit on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, the contractor mention — that's the visit item, not more of the GT1 compressor booking?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Mine's the site visit at Harbour Road with the contractor. Hannah's got the GT1 compressor booking. Two separate actions.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's all the new work covered. The reassignments are clear, and the safety-critical guarding stays straight away.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And my dryer delivery note is still just a blocker, yeah? Not another purchase-order chase against me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Neither supplier update became a new chase in this meeting. They're still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. Back to the truly contentious subject, then: whether bought brownies count.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Only if you take the price sticker off. Engineering judgement.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'm not signing that off. Cheers, everyone, we'll leave it there.
